title: MultiHashFormer: Hash-based Generative Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.28057v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Language models (LMs) represent tokens using embedding matrices that scale linearly with the vocabulary size. To constrain the parameter footprint, prior work proposes hashing many tokens into a single vector within encoder-only models. While this offers parameter efficiency, many-to-one collisions prevent its use in causal LMs. In this paper, we propose MultiHashFormer, a new framework that allows hash-based autoregression. Each token is represented as a unique hash signature, a short sequence of discrete hash IDs, generated by multiple independent hash functions. A Hash Encoder compresses this signature into a single latent vector for processing by a Transformer decoder. Then, a Hash Decoder generates the hash signature of the next token, which is then mapped back to text. We evaluate our approach at the 100M, 1B and 3B parameter scales, demonstrating that MultiHashFormer consistently outperforms standard Transformer LMs acro

translated_title: MultiHashFormer：基于哈希的生成式语言模型
translated_abstract: 语言模型（LM）使用与词表规模呈线性关系的嵌入矩阵来表示词元。为了限制参数规模，先前的工作提出在仅编码器模型中将多个词元哈希到单个向量中。虽然这带来了参数效率，但多对一的哈希冲突使其无法应用于因果语言模型。在本文中，我们提出了MultiHashFormer，一个支持基于哈希的自回归建模的新框架。每个词元被表示为一个唯一的哈希签名，即由多个独立哈希函数生成的一小段离散哈希ID序列。哈希编码器将该签名压缩为单个潜在向量，供Transformer解码器处理。随后，哈希解码器生成下一个词元的哈希签名，再将其映射回文本。我们在100M、1B和3B参数规模上评估了该方法，结果表明MultiHashFormer始终优于标准Transformer语言模型。
tldr: MultiHashFormer通过多独立哈希函数为每个词元生成唯一的哈希签名，并结合哈希编码器与哈希解码器实现了基于哈希的自回归语言建模，在保持参数高效的同时在多个参数规模上超越了标准Transformer语言模型。
en_tdlr: MultiHashFormer enables hash-based autoregressive language modeling by representing each token as a unique hash signature from multiple independent hash functions, achieving parameter-efficient causal LMs that consistently outperform standard Transformer LMs across scales.
